arXiv:2607.05381v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 7 月 6 日arXiv:2607.05381v1 [cs.LG] 06 Jul 2026

离散扩散模型学到什么？What Does a Discrete Diffusion Model Learn?

Rodrigo Casado Noguerales Correspondence: rcasado@ethz.ch ETH Zurich Bernhard Schölkopf ETH Zurich Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems, Tübingen ELLIS Institute Tübingen Thomas Hofmann ETH Zurich Aran Raoufi ETH Zurich
摘要Abstract

离散扩散模型学习什么：降噪器、得分比或桥接插件预测器？在跳跃率的层面上，这些是不同坐标中的一个对象，并且读取错误坐标中的神经网络会改变正在训练和采样的过程。从对任何噪声过程（包括边界项）的连续时间马尔可夫链 (CTMC) ELBO 的严格推导开始，我们证明了What does a discrete diffusion model learn: a denoiser, a score ratio, or a bridge plug-in predictor? At the level of jump rates, these are one object in different coordinates, and reading a neural network in the wrong coordinate changes the process being trained and sampled. Starting with a rigorous derivation of the continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) ELBO for any noising process, boundary terms included, we prove the甲骨文距离Oracle Distance定理：负 ELBO 恰好等于数据熵加上从预言逆向过程到学习过程的路径 KL，而不仅仅是一个界限。因此，其独特的优化器是给定当前噪声状态的真实反向跳跃率的条件期望，并且其不可约成本是前向过程的速率theorem: the negative ELBO is exactly equal to the data entropy plus the path KL from the oracle reverse process to the learned one, not merely a bound. Its unique optimizer is therefore the conditional expectation of the true reverse jump rate given the current noisy state, and its irreducible cost is the rate at which the forward processZtZ_{t}破坏有关干净数据的信息destroys information about the clean dataZ0Z_{0}, −dd​t​I​(Z0;Zt)-\tfrac{d}{dt}I(Z_{0};Z_{t})，因此每个噪声过程都共享相同的最佳可实现负 ELBO：数据熵。对于具有标记分解噪声的序列，预言机投影会为优化器生成三个精确坐标：降噪器、腔（桥接插件）和分数，并在它们之间进行封闭式转换。该框架确定了文献中每种损失实际优化的法则，将 MDM、UDM、SEDD 和 GIDD 作为特殊情况恢复；解释了为什么降噪器和腔体在掩蔽扩散中一致，但在均匀扩散中却不一致；证明降噪器参数化使得均匀 ELBO 在初始化时发散，同时桥接插件保持有限；并在初始化时精确校准 ELBO 实现。每个身份都在精确可解的模型上进行数值验证，无需近似。, so every noising process shares the same best achievable negative ELBO: the data entropy. For sequences with token-factorizing noise, the oracle projection yields three exact coordinates for the optimizer: denoiser, cavity (bridge plug-in), and score, with closed-form conversions among them. This framework identifies which law each loss in the literature actually optimizes, recovering MDM, UDM, SEDD, and GIDD as special cases; explains why denoiser and cavity coincide for masked diffusion but not for uniform diffusion; proves that a denoiser parameterization makes the uniform ELBO diverge at initialization while the bridge plug-in stays finite; and calibrates ELBO implementations exactly at initialization. Every identity is verified numerically, without approximation, on an exactly solvable model.

1 简介Introduction

离散扩散模型提供了一种对语言和其他分类数据进行生成建模的自然途径：直接在其字母表上破坏序列，然后学习向后运行破坏Discrete diffusion models offer a natural route to generative modeling on language and other categorical data: corrupt a sequence directly on its alphabet, then learn to run the corruption backward[2, 14]。连续时间马尔可夫链 (CTMC) 公式使这一点变得精确，用真正的跳跃过程取代选定的有限采样网格，以便生成模型由它引起的反向跳跃率确定. Continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) formulations make this precise, replacing a chosen finite sampling grid by a genuine jump process, so that a generative model is determined by the reverse jump rates it induces[6].

本文从一个简单的观察开始。在离散扩散文献中，学习的反向过程是通过几个明显不同的对象（降噪器、得分比、桥接插件、留一预测器、屏蔽令牌损失、有限步反向内核）来描述的。This paper starts from a simple observation. In the discrete-diffusion literature the learned reverse process is described through several apparently different objects (denoisers, score ratios, bridge plug-ins, leave-one-out predictors, masked-token losses, finite-step reverse kernels[21, 32, 42]），通常被视为同一型号的替代名称。他们不是。神经网络的输出不是一个逆过程，直到指定如何将其转换为跳跃率，并且在错误的坐标中读取相同的输出会改变正在优化和采样的连续时间马尔可夫链。), often treated as alternative names for the same model. They are not. A neural network’s output is not a reverse process until one specifies how it is converted into jump rates, and reading the same output in the wrong coordinate changes the continuous-time Markov chain being optimized and sampled from.

这种区别并不纯粹是学术上的。在均匀扩散中，标准桥插件目标不会训练从完整噪声序列中预测干净标记的普通降噪器；它训练一个This distinction is not purely academic. In uniform diffusion, the standard bridge-plug-in objective does not train an ordinary denoiser that predicts the clean token from the full noisy sequence; it trains a空腔cavitylaw，一个使用噪声上下文的预测器，但不以其将要修改的本地噪声标记为条件。掩模扩散隐藏了这一点，因为在掩模位置，局部观察不携带有关干净令牌的信息，因此降噪器和腔体重合。均匀扩散和混合扩散没有这种抵消，对于它们来说，坐标之间的转换是模型的分析部分，而不是实现细节。law, a predictor that uses the noisy context but does not condition on the local noisy token it is about to revise. Masked diffusion hides this because, at a masked position, the local observation carries no information about the clean token, so denoiser and cavity coincide. Uniform and hybrid diffusion have no such cancellation, and for them the conversion between coordinates is an analytic part of the model, not an implementation detail.

因此，中心问题是：The central question is therefore:负 ELBO 最小化实际上优化了什么？what does negative-ELBO minimization actually optimize?我们的答案是基于路径的。连续时间 ELBO 不是似然性的松散替代，而是两个反向跳跃过程之间的精确路径法则散度，即由前向噪声法则确定的预言过程和模型引起的学习过程，我们将其称为恒等式Our answer is path-based. The continuous-time ELBO is not a loose surrogate for likelihood but an exact path-law divergence between two reverse jump processes, the oracle process determined by the forward noising law and the learned process induced by the model, an identity we call the甲骨文距离Oracle Distance（定理(Theorem3）。因此，训练使模型完全相反). Training therefore makes the model’s entire reverse轨迹trajectory，不仅是其端点分布，与预言机的匹配。, not only its endpoint distribution, match the oracle’s.

在无穷小级别，训练观察干净的数据，因此可以访问干净条件的反向桥；采样不会，并且学习率可能仅取决于当前访问的噪声状态。因此，ELBO 执行At the infinitesimal level, training observes the clean data and so has access to the clean-conditioned reverse bridge; sampling does not, and the learned rate may depend only on the noisy state currently visited. The ELBO therefore performs a投影projection：它对噪声状态下可用的后验信息平均干净条件桥接率，结果正是生成所需的边际反向率，即回归和流匹配背后的条件均值原理的跳跃过程模拟。: it averages the clean-conditioned bridge rate over the posterior information available at the noisy state, and the result is exactly the marginal reverse rate needed for generation, the jump-process analogue of the conditional-mean principle behind regression and flow matching.

该预测还解释了目标的价值：一旦考虑了固定的数据熵下限和端点项，剩下的不可约部分正是前向过程破坏的信息，在扩散时间内积累。每个噪声过程都支付相同的总预言机价格，它们的不同之处仅在于花费时间和地点，以及所选择的参数化如何影响最终的学习问题。This projection also explains the value of the objective: once the fixed data-entropy floor and endpoint terms are accounted for, the irreducible part of what remains is exactly the information the forward process destroys, accumulated over diffusion time. Every noising process pays the same total oracle price, and they differ only in when and where they spend it, and in how the chosen parameterization conditions the resulting learning problem.

对于标记因子分解噪声过程，投影产生显式的For token-factorizing noising processes the projection yields an explicit字典dictionary：相同的反向速率可以写在降噪器、空腔或分数坐标中，每个坐标都有效，但只有在正确转换后才有效。这立即解决了几个难题：为什么掩蔽扩散会减少到普通的去噪交叉熵，为什么桥插件以均匀扩散中的空腔定律为目标，为什么去噪器参数化在干净端点附近会出现病态，以及基于分数的离散扩散如何适应同一连续时间对象。然后，同一镜头将训练模型的两个误差源分开：ELBO 测量的反向速率误差和仅采样揭示的因式分解误差。: the same reverse rate can be written in denoiser, cavity, or score coordinates, each valid but only after the correct conversion. This resolves several puzzles at once: why masked diffusion reduces to ordinary denoising cross-entropy, why the bridge plug-in targets a cavity law in uniform diffusion, why a denoiser parameterization can be ill-conditioned near the clean endpoint, and how score-based discrete diffusion fits into the same continuous-time object. The same lens then separates the two error sources of a trained model: the reverse-rate error that the ELBO measures, and the factorization error that only sampling reveals.

贡献。Contributions.

本文给出了一个独立的、连续时间离散扩散的一般理论； §This paper gives a self-contained, general theory of continuous-time discrete diffusion; §2调查了核心结果和见解，我们建议从那里开始，将完整的推导推迟到§§surveys the core results and insights and we recommend starting there, deferring the full derivations to §§4–7以及相关工作§and related work to §3。具体来说，我们的主要贡献是：. Concretely, our main contributions are:

  • •

    通用 CTMC ELBO。A general CTMC ELBO.建立在Building on[6]，我们推导出有限状态跳跃过程的连续时间离散扩散 ELBO，及其重构和终端先验边界项、明确定义它的支持和正则条件，以及两个互补的推导（无穷小 KL 极限和 Girsanov 论证）。结果是任何前向噪声过程的训练目标的机械配方。, we derive the continuous-time discrete-diffusion ELBO for finite-state jump processes, with its reconstruction and terminal-prior boundary terms, the support and regularity conditions under which it is well defined, and two complementary derivations (an infinitesimal-KL limit and a Girsanov argument). The result is a mechanical recipe for the training objective of any forward noising process.

  • •

    ELBO 作为路径分歧：Oracle 距离。The ELBO as path divergence: the Oracle Distance.将固定熵和端点项分开后，负 ELBO 正是从预言逆过程到学习过程的逆时间路径散度（定理After the fixed entropy and endpoint terms are separated, the negative ELBO is exactly the reverse-time path divergence from the oracle reverse process to the learned one (Theorem3）。因此，目标是反向动态之间的距离，而不仅仅是可能性界限。). The objective is therefore a distance between reverse dynamics, not merely a likelihood bound.

  • •

    ELBO 作为反向利率预测。The ELBO as a reverse-rate projection.从当前噪声状态下可用的信息来看，总体优化器是干净条件反向桥接速率的后验平均值。这产生了不可约信息丢失和模型不匹配的毕达哥拉斯分解，并确定了通用的预言底，即数据熵。The population optimizer is the posterior average of the clean-conditioned reverse bridge rate, viewed from the information available at the current noisy state. This yields a Pythagorean decomposition into irreducible information loss and model mismatch, and identifies the universal oracle floor, the data entropy.

  • •

    一种反向速率，三种坐标。One reverse rate, three coordinates.对于产品 CTMC，我们在降噪器、空腔和分数坐标中表达相同的最佳反向率，并在它们之间进行封闭形式的转换。这确定了在掩蔽扩散、均匀扩散、基于分数和混合离散扩散中哪种法则得到优化；特别是，标准桥插件是通过空腔定律而不是降噪器来优化的。For product CTMCs we express the same optimal reverse rate in denoiser, cavity, and score coordinates, with closed-form conversions among them. This identifies which law is optimized in masked, uniform, score-based, and hybrid discrete diffusion; in particular, the standard bridge plug-in is optimized by the cavity law, not the denoiser.

  • •

    实际后果。Practical consequences.该词典解释了为什么掩蔽扩散允许普通的去噪交叉熵、为什么去噪器参数化对于均匀和完全支持混合扩散来说是病态的，以及为什么桥接插件以空腔定律为目标；它在初始化时校准 ELBO 实现，包括通常在跨方法比较中删除的边界项；它将 ELBO 测量的训练模型的反向率误差与 ELBO 看不到的并行令牌采样的因式分解误差分开。The dictionary explains why masked diffusion admits ordinary denoising cross-entropy, why denoiser parameterizations are ill-conditioned for uniform and full-support hybrid diffusion, and why the bridge plug-in targets a cavity law; it calibrates ELBO implementations at initialization, including the boundary terms usually dropped in cross-method comparisons; and it separates a trained model’s reverse-rate error, which the ELBO measures, from the factorization error of parallel-token sampling, which the ELBO cannot see.

扩散模型将从复杂的数据分布中进行采样转化为逆转简单噪声过程的问题。选择正向随机过程Diffusion models turn sampling from a complicated data distribution into the problem of reversing a simple noising process. One chooses a forward stochastic process(Zt)t∈[0,T](Z_{t})_{t\in[0,T]}其边缘whose marginalsqt:=Law​(Zt)q_{t}:=\mathrm{Law}(Z_{t})在数据规律之间进行插值interpolate between the data lawq0=pdataq_{0}=p_{\mathrm{data}}和终极法则and a terminal lawqTq_{T}从中取样很容易；然后生成减少到学习反向动态：样本from which sampling is easy; generation then reduces to learning the reverse dynamics: sampleZT∼qTZ_{T}\sim q_{T}，运行一个近似逆过程回到零时间，并希望得到的定律接近于, run an approximate reverse process back to time zero, and hope that the resulting law is close toq0q_{0}。在离散扩散中，噪声过程直接破坏其有限字母表上的数据，因此要反转的对象是离散马尔可夫演化，而不是欧几里得空间中的高斯扰动。. In discrete diffusion the noising process corrupts data directly on its finite alphabet, so the object to reverse is a discrete Markov evolution rather than a Gaussian perturbation in Euclidean space.

连续时间和反向跳跃率。Continuous time and the reverse jump rate.

从离散链传递到连续时间马尔可夫链 (CTMC) 消除了离散化级别的任意选择Passing from a discrete chain to a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) removes the arbitrary choice of a discretization levelNN，允许对时间点进行连续采样，并使时间变化或重要性采样时钟成为数学公式的一部分，而不是实现细节。它还揭示了模型试图学习的无穷小对象：反向跳跃率。这在实践中很有用，因为模型可以从随机采样时间进行训练，无需固定采样网格；在数学上，因为 ELBO 成为路径空间相对熵，并且在跳跃率方面具有精确的局部表达式。为了导出这个连续时间 ELBO，我们首先介绍一些符号。, allows time points to be sampled continuously, and makes time changes or importance-sampling clocks part of the mathematical formulation rather than implementation details. It also exposes the infinitesimal object that the model is trying to learn: the reverse jump rate. This is useful both practically, because models can be trained from randomly sampled times and without fixing the sampling grid, and mathematically, because the ELBO becomes the path-space relative entropy and has an exact local expression in terms of jump rates. To derive this continuous-time ELBO, let us introduce first some notation.

重新审视推导有两个原因。首先，许多演示文稿放弃了 ELBO 的模型独立项，因为它们不影响优化。当目标只是获得损失函数时，这是很自然的，但它隐藏了目标的信息论结构。在本文中，我们保留这些术语并表明它们不是装饰性的：它们通过前向过程破坏的信息来识别 ELBO 的不可约成本，并且它们导致反向模型实际学习的内容的路径空间分解。There are two reasons to revisit the derivation. First, many presentations discard model-independent terms of the ELBO because they do not affect optimization. This is natural when the goal is only to obtain a loss function, but it hides the information-theoretic structure of the objective. In this paper we keep these terms and show that they are not decorative: they identify the irreducible cost of the ELBO with the information destroyed by the forward process, and they lead to a path-space decomposition of what the reverse model is actually learning.

其次，实际实现很少会在不进行修改的情况下优化理想的全间隔目标。端点行为Second, practical implementations rarely optimize the ideal full-interval objective without modification. Endpoint behavior att=0,Tt=0,T可能是奇异的或数值不稳定的，后验比可能具有高方差，重建和终端先验选择可能与路径损耗分开，蒙特卡罗训练通常使用时间窗或重要性采样时钟。由于这些原因，人们经常将间隔截断为can be singular or numerically unstable, posterior ratios may have high variance, reconstruction and terminal-prior choices may be separated from the path loss, and Monte Carlo training often uses time windows or importance-sampling clocks. For these reasons one often truncates the interval to[t1,t2]⊂(0,T)[t_{1},t_{2}]\subset(0,T)。然而，一旦完成此操作，对 ELBO 的影响就不再是透明的：在全区间或完全匹配设置中无害的边界项对于将目标解释为可能性界限变得至关重要。. Once this is done, however, the effect on the ELBO is no longer transparent: the boundary terms that were harmless in the full-interval or perfectly matched setting become essential for interpreting the objective as a likelihood bound.

解释 ELBO 的困难。The difficulties interpreting the ELBO.

ELBO 的明显缺点是它是一种不等式：它似乎用可计算的界限取代了棘手的可能性，正如其名称所反映的那样。事实上，考虑到期望（The perceived drawback of the ELBO is that it is an inequality: it seemingly replaces the intractable likelihood by a computable bound, as reflected in its name. KL⁡(pdata∥p0θ)≤−H​(q0)−𝔼q0​[ELBO[t1,t2]⁡(θ;z0)].\operatorname{KL}\!\left(p_{\mathrm{data}}\,\middle\|\,p^{\theta}_{0}\right)\leq-H(q_{0})-\mathbb{E}_{q_{0}}\bigl[\operatorname{ELBO}_{[t_{1},t_{2}]}(\theta;\,z_{0})\bigr].

一个有界限的度量很难解释。如果两篇论文报告了不同的 ELBO 值，并且报告的数字只是具有未知间隙的 KL 散度的上限，则更好的值是否反映更好的生成律或仅反映更严格的变分近似并不明显。这在文本和音乐等领域尤其严重，因为很难定义生成样本的直接度量。A metric which is a bound is hard to interpret. If two papers report different ELBO values, and the reported number is only an upper bound on a KL divergence with an unknown gap, it is not obvious whether a better value reflects a better generative law or only a tighter variational approximation. This is especially acute in domains such as text and music, where direct metrics on generated samples are difficult to define.

还有两个特定于扩散模型的结构性问题。一、ELBO列车There are also two structural questions specific to diffusion models. First, the ELBO trainsQ^θ\widehat{Q}^{\theta}通过局部分歧through the local divergenceΦ(Q^t(⋅∣z0),Q^tθ)\Phi(\widehat{Q}_{t}(\cdot\mid z_{0}),\widehat{Q}_{t}^{\theta})，其中第一个参数是干净条件下的反向速率，而生成需要边际反向 CTMC 速率, where the first argument is the clean-conditioned reverse rate, whereas generation requires the marginal reverse CTMC with rateQ^t\widehat{Q}_{t}。那么，目标的人口优化器是什么？其次，ELBO 本身可实现的最佳价值是多少？在本文中，我们通过用路径空间相对熵识别 ELBO 以及具有直接信息论意义的常数来回答这些问题。. What, then, is the population optimizer of the objective? Second, what is the best achievable value of the ELBO itself? In this paper, we answer these questions by identifying the ELBO with a path-space relative entropy, plus constants with direct information-theoretic meaning.

3 背景及相关工作Background and related work

离散扩散及其连续时间形式。Discrete diffusion and its continuous-time form.

离散扩散起源于多项式和结构化的分类腐败过程Discrete diffusion originates with multinomial and structured categorical corruption processes[14, 2]，高斯扩散线的离散模拟, the discrete analogue of the Gaussian diffusion line[39, 12]，现在扩展到大型语言模型, and now scales to large language models[24]。坎贝尔等人。. Campbell et al.[6]将离散扩散转换为连续时间马尔可夫链 (CTMC)，具有精确的正向和反向速率以及连续时间变分界限，随后通过基于分数进行扩展cast discrete diffusion as a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) with exact forward and reverse rates and a continuous-time variational bound, later extended by score-based[40, 21]和基于流量的and flow-based[8, 7]公式，并通过去噪马尔可夫模型推广到广泛的马尔可夫过程formulations, and generalized to broad classes of Markov processes by denoising Markov models[4]和发电机匹配and Generator Matching[13]。第§节. Section §4是基于 CTMC ELBO 的独立重新派生is a self-contained re-derivation of the CTMC ELBO building on[6]，具有明确的重建和终端先验边界项以及速率支持和正则性条件，并具有两个推导（无穷小 KL 论证和 Girsanov 论证，定理, with the reconstruction and terminal-prior boundary terms and the rate-support and regularity conditions made explicit, and with two derivations (an infinitesimal-KL argument and a Girsanov argument, Theorem2）。现有的离散公式将边界项吸收为与模型无关的常数或将它们发送到零). Existing discrete formulations absorb the boundary terms into model-independent constants or send them to zero withT→∞T\to\infty [6, 21, 32, 17]，这使得报告的 ELBO 在实施的噪声过程中无法比较；我们始终保持它们的明确性，这使得§的跨流程校准结果成为可能, which makes reported ELBOs incomparable across noising processes as implemented; we keep them explicit throughout, which is what enables the cross-process calibration results of §6。据我们所知，没有任何离散扩散工作能够用边界项来说明任意模型速率的确切恒等式。我们框架中的其他见解，例如重要性采样和过程的时间参数化之间的等价性，与似然忠实与重新加权的扩散目标相关. To our knowledge, no discrete-diffusion work states the exact identity, with boundary terms, for arbitrary model rates. Other insights from our framework, such as the equivalence between importance sampling and the process’ time parameterization, connect to likelihood-faithful versus reweighted diffusion objectives[18, 23, 38, 29].

逆向过程参数化。Reverse-process parameterizations.

学习到的逆过程以多种方式参数化：作为降噪器The learned reverse process is parameterized in several ways: as a denoiser[2, 14, 6, 32, 37]，作为具体分数, as a concrete score[22, 40, 21, 26, 43]，或作为留一法或空洞法, or as a leave-one-out or cavity law[42, 9, 35, 33, 34]，屏蔽 ELBO 减少为加权交叉熵, with the masked ELBO reducing to weighted cross-entropy[37, 32, 44]。最近的两个框架统一了其中的子集： 生成器匹配. Two recent frameworks unify subsets of these: Generator Matching[13]回归边际马尔可夫过程生成器和目标具体分数匹配regresses a marginal Markov-process generator, and Target Concrete Score Matching[43]通过目标具体分数统一训练目标，恢复几个现有的屏蔽和基于分数的目标作为特殊情况。特别是，生成器匹配在匹配目标的层面上已经包含了我们使用的两个成分：作为条件生成器的后验平均值的边际生成器，以及作为损失类的 Bregman 散度，其条件形式和边际形式共享梯度（它们的命题 1-2）。它没有提供我们所做的是可能性方面：精确的 CTMC NELBO，包括边界项，unifies training objectives through the target concrete score, recovering several existing masked and score-based objectives as special cases. Generator Matching in particular already contains, at the level of matching objectives, two ingredients we use: the marginal generator as a posterior average of conditional generators, and Bregman divergences as the loss class whose conditional and marginal forms share gradients (their Propositions 1–2). What it does not provide that we do is the likelihood side: the exact CTMC NELBO, boundary terms included,is这样的布雷格曼目标such a Bregman objective forΦ\Phi，所以投影最优是最大-ELBO逆过程，预言之上的多余部分是路径KL，不可约部分是信息破坏率。第§节, so the projection optimum is the maximum-ELBO reverse process, the excess above the oracle is a path KL, and the irreducible part is the information-destruction rate. Section §6在参数化层面是互补的：我们给出了一个明确的目标，而不是单一的目标is complementary at the parameterization level: rather than a single objective, we give an explicit坐标字典coordinate dictionary使用精确的转换公式计算所有降噪器、空腔和分数参数化的反向率，并确定每个文献损失优化的坐标。先前的工作经常模糊位置与序列级别的区别，并在另一个采样器中读取一个网络而不进行转换，分数线of the reverse rate for all denoiser, cavity, and score parameterizations, with exact conversion formulas, and identify which coordinate each literature loss optimizes. Prior work often blurs the position- versus sequence-level distinction and reads one network in another’s sampler without converting, the score line[21, 26]和独立均匀扩散分析and the independent uniform-diffusion analysis of[9]是最接近的例外。being the closest exceptions.

降噪器与留一法的区别。The denoiser-versus-leave-one-out distinction.

Gourevitch 等人同时且独立地。Concurrently and independently, Gourevitch et al.[9]最近观察到，对于均匀扩散 (UDM) 的特殊情况，桥接插件是通过留一法（腔）法而不是标准降噪器来优化的，从而导出 UDM 的降噪器/留一法/分数转换，用于改进 UDM 训练和采样。我们的工作通过不同的途径获得了这一结果，将其置于通用产品 CTMC 治疗中。甲骨文距离定理have recently observed for the special case of uniform diffusion (UDM) that the bridge plug-in is optimized by a leave-one-out (cavity) law rather than the standard denoiser, deriving denoiser/leave-one-out/score conversions for UDM that they use to improve UDM training and sampling. Our work obtains this result by a different route that places it within a general product-CTMC treatment. The Oracle Distance Theorem3它引起的反向速率投影表征了降噪器、空腔和分数最佳值及其转换公式，and the reverse-rate projection it induces characterize the denoiser, cavity, and score optima, and their conversion formulas, for每个every来自单一投影原理的可令牌分解的噪声过程。我们的框架还准确解释了坐标何时以及为何不同，以及何时降噪器参数化使 ELBO 不适定，并具有 UDM 的明确发散率（命题token-factorizable noising process from a single projection principle. Our framework also explains exactly when and why the coordinates differ and when a denoiser parameterization makes the ELBO ill-posed, with explicit divergence rates for UDM (Proposition6）给出了 Gourevitch 等人的留一优势的理论解释。凭经验记录。此外，他们在文本建模方面的经验收益提供了强有力的证据，表明精确的反向率过程和优化的预言法则等区别远非纯粹的学术性，并且对离散扩散建模具有可测量的影响。) that give a theoretical account of the leave-one-out advantage that Gourevitch et al. document empirically. Furthermore, their empirical gains on text modelling provide strong evidence that distinctions such as the exact reverse-rate process and oracle law being optimized are far from purely academic and have a measurable effect on discrete diffusion modeling.

4 连续时间离散扩散框架A continuous-time discrete diffusion framework

本节和以下部分中的证明遵循一种重复出现的模式：识别精确的逆马尔可夫过程，然后询问模型可以代表其中的哪一部分。在认识到扩散模型是一个 VAE，其潜伏是噪声轨迹后，推导 ELBO 界的变分步骤是标准的；在连续时间内，桥核 KL 的离散和变成局部跳跃率散度的路径积分The proofs in this and the following sections follow one recurring pattern: identify the exact reverse Markov process, then ask what part of it a model can represent. The variational step to deduce the ELBO bound is standard after realizing that a diffusion model is a VAE whose latent is the noising trajectory; in continuous time the discrete sum of bridge-kernel KLs becomes a path integral of local jump-rate divergencesΦ​(Q^t​(zt,y∣z0),Q^tθ​(zt,y))\Phi(\widehat{Q}_{t}(z_{t},y\mid z_{0}),\widehat{Q}_{t}^{\theta}(z_{t},y))，加上下端点处的重建项和上端点处的终端先验项。这是第 § 节的 CTMC ELBO, plus a reconstruction term at the lower endpoint and a terminal-prior term at the upper endpoint. This is the CTMC ELBO of Section §4.3，可以作为离散时间 ELBO 的消失网格极限获得，也可以直接作为使用 Girsanov 公式的跳跃过程之间的相对熵获得。, obtained either as a vanishing-mesh limit of the discrete-time ELBO or directly as the relative entropy between jump processes using Girsanov’s formula.

真正的桥接率仍然取决于隐藏的干净数据The true bridge rate still depends on the hidden clean dataZ0Z_{0}，而学习到的反向 CTMC 只看到噪声状态, whereas the learned reverse CTMC sees only the noisy stateZtZ_{t}。因此，ELBO 提出了局部投影问题，其最小者为. 备注1Remark 1 （时间之箭和独立机制）(The arrow of time and independent mechanisms).

这些结果与因果推理的独立机制原理有着有趣的联系These results have an intriguing connection to the independent mechanisms principle from causal inference[36]。在路径律层面上，两个时间方向之间不存在不对称性（一个过程在正向时间上是马尔可夫当且仅当它在反向时间上是马尔可夫时）。在向前的方向上，描述分解为两个独立的机制：初始条件（数据定律. At the path-law level there is no asymmetry between the two time directions (a process is Markov in forward time if and only if it is Markov in reverse time). In the forward direction, the description factorizes into two independent mechanisms: an initial condition (the data lawq0q_{0}）和动力学定律（生成器) and a dynamical law (the generatorQtQ_{t}），在彼此不知情的情况下进行选择 - 噪声机制不包含有关数据的信息。向后看，这种独立性被破坏了：通过（), chosen without knowledge of each other — the noising mechanism contains no information about the data. Backward, this independence is destroyed: by (14), 反向发电机), the reverse generatorQ^t​(x,y)=Qt​(y,x)​qt​(y)qt​(x)\widehat{Q}_{t}(x,y)=Q_{t}(y,x)\,\frac{q_{t}(y)}{q_{t}(x)}需要边际requires the marginalsqtq_{t}从而产生了数据定律。詹津等人。and hence the data law. Janzing et al.[16]正是从初始状态和动力学的这种独立性中推导出热力学时间箭头。类似的逻辑——通过模型类的限制而实现的不对称——是时间序列中因果方向检测的基础：由一个方向上的独立噪声驱动的机制可表示的过程通常不承认在另一个方向上有这样的表示，这就是使方向可识别的原因derive the thermodynamic arrow of time from precisely this independence of initial state and dynamics. A similar logic — asymmetry through restriction of the model class — underlies causal direction detection in time series: a process representable by mechanisms driven by independent noise in one direction generically admits no such representation in the other, which is what renders the direction identifiable[27, 28]。我们对离散扩散的看法就是这种不对称性的一个例子：前向过程属于数据无关、位置因子化机制的一小类，而它的逆转，每当. Our view on discrete diffusion is an instance of this asymmetry: the forward process belongs to the small class of data-independent, position-factorized mechanisms, whereas its reversal, wheneverq0q_{0}跨位置相关，仅存在于较大类的数据依赖生成器中，而训练的目的就是提供这种依赖性。目前的框架明确量化了细分：互信息is correlated across positions, exists only in the larger class of data-dependent generators — and the purpose of training is to supply that dependence. 9 结论Conclusion

我们已经给出了连续时间离散扩散 ELBO 的独立、严格的解释，具有明确的边界项，并用它在两个层面上回答了标题的问题。在目标层面，NELBO 不仅仅是一个似然界限：它等于数据熵加上从预言机逆向过程到学习过程的路径 KL（预言机距离，定理We have given a self-contained, rigorous account of the continuous-time discrete-diffusion ELBO, with explicit boundary terms, and used it to answer the question of the title at two levels. At the level of the objective, the NELBO is not merely a likelihood bound: it equals the data entropy plus the path KL from the oracle reverse process to the learned one (the Oracle Distance, Theorem3）；它不可减少的部分是信息丢失率); its irreducible part is the rate of information lossdd​t​H​(Z0∣Zt)\tfrac{d}{dt}H(Z_{0}\mid Z_{t})，其最佳可实现值是数据熵, and its best achievable value is the data entropyH​(pdata)H(p_{\mathrm{data}})，对于每个噪声过程。在学习对象的层面上，离散扩散模型学习, for every noising process. At the level of the learned object, a discrete diffusion model learns the边际反向跳跃率marginal reverse jump rate、清洁调节率的后验平均值以及降噪器、空腔和分数参数化是该对象的三个坐标（表, the posterior average of the clean-conditioned rate, and the denoiser, cavity, and score parameterizations are three coordinates of this one object (Table3），通过精确转换相关。这一观点将分散的结构转化为一个配方的实例，并产生具体的结果：封闭形式的每过程 ELBO，其边界项使报告值在噪声过程中具有可比性（§), related by exact conversions. This viewpoint turns scattered constructions into instances of one recipe, with concrete consequences: closed-form per-process ELBOs whose boundary terms make reported values comparable across noising processes (§7, 表, Table5), 的), thelog⁡V\log V腔体校准（命题cavity calibration (Proposition4），降噪器坐标散度解释了为什么降噪器头在均匀和 GIDD 噪声下更难训练（命题), the denoiser-coordinate divergence that explains why the denoiser head is harder to train under uniform and GIDD noising (Proposition6），并且掩蔽扩散的原因很特殊：降噪器和腔定律一致（推论), and the reason masked diffusion is special: there the denoiser and cavity laws coincide (Corollary4），这样区别就消失了。在精确可解模型上，这些恒等式（共享楼层、Oracle 距离衰减、反向利率投影和转换或支付罚金）中的每一个都在数字上得到确认，而无需近似。), and the distinction disappears. On an exactly-solvable model, each of these identities (the shared floor, the Oracle Distance decay, the reverse-rate projection, and the convert-or-pay penalties) is confirmed numerically without approximation.

我们的分析表征了Our analysis characterizes the老师强迫teacher-forced目标：反向率在噪声状态下回归objective: the reverse rate is regressed at noisy stateszt∼qt∣0z_{t}\sim q_{t\mid 0}来自真实的前向过程，而不是模型从其自身轨迹采样时访问的状态。这是一个一致的目标。在明确指定的、无限容量、无限数据限制中，学习速率与真实反向速率相匹配drawn from the true forward process, not at the states a model visits when sampling from its own trajectory. This is a consistent target. In the well-specified, infinite-capacity, infinite-data limit the learned rate matches the true reverse rate at每个every状态，因此 rollout 永远不会离开state, so rollout never leavesqtq_{t}并且不会发生漂移。因此，采样漂移是有限容量的and no drift occurs. Sampling drift is therefore a finite-capacity概括generalization差距（学习率很难推断出自我生成的、低gap (the learned rate extrapolates poorly to self-generated, low-qtq_{t}状态）而不是目标的缺陷，这是比通常将曝光偏差解读为目标不匹配更精确的陈述。这里的干净结果，即布雷格曼投影最佳值、到预言机的精确距离和熵底，所有这些都以教师强制状态为前提；相反，目标或采样器以自生成状态为目标，获得了对漂移的鲁棒性，但失去了这些精确的特征。states) rather than a defect of the objective, a more precise statement than the usual reading of exposure bias as objective mismatch. The clean results here, namely the Bregman projection optimum, the exact distance to the oracle, and the entropy floor, all presuppose teacher-forced states; objectives or samplers that instead target self-generated states gain robustness to drift but lose these exact characterizations.

自然的后续步骤有两个限制。首先，我们的验证是在一个受控的、可精确求解的模型上进行的，选择该模型是为了使每个预言量都以封闭形式提供；确认坐标转换增益在模型尺度上持续存在是自然的下一步，并且并发的均匀扩散结果Two limitations point to the natural next steps. First, our validation is on a controlled, exactly-solvable model, chosen so that every oracle quantity is available in closed form; confirming that the coordinate-conversion gains persist at model scale is the natural next step, and the concurrent uniform-diffusion results of[9]已经为统一的特殊情况提供了这种规模的证据。其次，反向率/分解分裂（§already provide such evidence at that scale for the uniform special case. Second, the reverse-rate/factorization split (§2.2) 隔离两个互补且可单独寻址的误差源：非分布状态下的反向速率误差，可通过漂移感知训练或添加容量和数据来减少；有限步数的因式分解误差，可通过校正器或自校正采样器减少。在整个降噪器/腔体/分数系列以及噪声过程中缩放转换或付费比较，是我们字典精确的具体程序。它留给从业者的单一操作规则很简单：在其损失优化的坐标中学习头部，或者在采样之前在坐标之间进行分析转换。) isolates two complementary and separately addressable error sources: reverse-rate error at off-distribution states, reducible through drift-aware training or added capacity and data; and factorization error at finite step count, reducible through corrector or self-correcting samplers. Scaling the convert-or-pay comparison across the full denoiser/cavity/score family, and across noising processes, is a concrete program our dictionary makes precise. The single operational rule it leaves the practitioner is simple: learn a head in the coordinate its loss optimizes, or convert between coordinates analytically before you sample.
